title: 2 BHK Residential Home
subtitle: College Project · Complete 3D Model
summary: A college-assigned 2 BHK residential interior project developed as a complete 3D model, exploring spatial planning, materials, lighting and a calm contemporary language.
brief: Create a calm, contemporary home that feels personal rather than showy, with comfortable social areas, well-planned private zones and seamless storage.
concept: Quiet luxury expressed through layered neutrals, natural textures, sculptural lighting and carefully controlled visual clutter.
